results.title: PTI demands cardiac care for ex-Pak PM Imran Khan
results.description: Islamabad, Aug 24: Former Pakistan prime minister Imran Khan’s party has condemned what it called the “continued failure” of authorities at a state-run hospital after the CT Coronary Angiography (CTA) was not conducted on him despite cardiologists complaining about potential risks of cardiac complications. results.title: California to sue Trump administration again over mail-in voting restrictions
results.description: SACRAMENTO, Calif. — Gov. Gavin Newsom announced Monday that California intends to sue the Trump administration again over President Donald Trump’s efforts to impose new restrictions on mail-in voting ahead of the November midterms.

results.title: Teacher slapped four-year-old across face in ‘serious misconduct’
results.description: Shifali Arora was censured for serious misconduct by the New Zealand Teachers Disciplinary Tribunal following the incident at Lollipops Takanini in July 2020.
